analysis:
The PR is documentation-only: docs/developer/desktop-app.md (release-qualification bullet, lines ~554-556, plus the update-feed paragraph around 107-113 seen in the patch) and docs/operations/desktop-release.md (new 'The update feed' section at head lines 70-88, rollback guidance at 103-106). It documents a GUI self-update channel: a fixed generic electron-updater feed at the GitHub Release 'desktop-latest', a latest-mac.yml with sha512 and size checks, uploads with the manifest last, and a 4-hour check cadence. No code, workflow or config is changed in the supplied units, so I found no regression against the retained threat model.

Security-relevant claims that the next pass should verify against the actual workflow and app code, which are not in this batch:
(1) The feed is fixed at build time, and release builds refuse to build without it.
(2) macOS accepts an update only if it is signed by the same Developer ID. The docs assert this, but electron-updater on macOS relies on Squirrel.Mac code-signature validation. latest-mac.yml sha512 is integrity only, not authenticity, since the manifest sits in the same GitHub Release as the zip.
(3) Trust in the 'desktop-latest' release depends on who has write access to the repo's releases. Pushing a tag now ships to every installed app, which the docs acknowledge (head line 9). Tag and release permissions, and the workflow's protections around the signing secrets, are outside the evidence.
(4) The rollback procedure (uploading an older latest-mac.yml) is a manual control. The statement that the updater never downgrades is a documented assumption.

The update channel is new attack surface on the provider-operator desktop client, which relates to the binary-trust and build-qualification themes (T-013, T-034). The retained threat model has no explicit entry for the desktop GUI update channel. This may merit a threat-model addition, but it is not a concrete regression here. The bundled CLI/provider artifact is updated separately via darkbloom update, so the provider attestation and App Attest boundaries (TB-009, TB-011) are not touched. T-041 was supplied but is not affected by this change.
